Metadata.defaultTitle: Touhou Music Quiz — Endless Edition | Guess the Track from a Random Clip
Metadata.keywords: Touhou Project, Touhou music, Touhou original music, Touhou music quiz, Touhou song quiz, Touhou track quiz, name that tune, Touhou Music Cognitive Test
Metadata.description: An endless quiz that tests your knowledge of Touhou Project music. Choose the tracks you want to be quizzed on, then identify them from random 10-, 5-, 1-, or 0.5-second clips. There is no limit to the number of questions.

Choose which tracks may appear in the quiz.
Click a selected category again to select or deselect all tracks in that category.
All tracks from the Windows Games are selected by default.
